Les régions de Leonida Les six régions o: the regions of leonida the six official regions of gta vi: vice city, leonida keys, grassrivers, port gellhorn, ambrosia and mount kalaga, with official images and a map.
vice city région vice city réunit plages: vice city region vice city brings together beaches, shopping districts, a cruise port and downtown skyscrapers. rockstar mentions ocean beach, little cuba, tisha-wocka and vc port, and makes it the densest, liveliest area of leonida. the capital of sun and excess, far from the 80s but just as hungry.
leonida keys région un archipel tropical: leonida keys region a tropical archipelago linked by long roads over the water. people live off fishing, waterfront bars and quiet smuggling: jason lives there in a property owned by brian heder, whose boatyard still moves merchandise. a string of islands where people live off the sea, fishing and quiet smuggling.
grassrivers région la plus vaste étendue: grassrivers region the country’s largest subtropical wilderness: mangroves, slow canals and flooded plains you cross by airboat. rockstar calls it the untamed jewel of leonida, as beautiful as it is dangerous. the wild swamps of leonida, where the alligator is the most famous attraction.
port gellhorn région ancienne destinatio: port gellhorn region once a vacation destination, port gellhorn now lives off what’s left: cheap motels, empty malls and closed attractions. a place to disappear and take the jobs nobody wants. a faded beach resort, between cheap motels and closed attractions.
ambrosia région le versant agricole et i: ambrosia region the farming and industrial side of leonida, built around the allied crystal sugar refinery. it provides the jobs; a local biker gang provides, according to rockstar, pretty much everything else. the industrial heart of the state, where american industry and old values still rule.
mount kalaga national park région le par: mount kalaga national park region the national park in northern leonida: forests, hills, rivers and muddy trails. rockstar presents it as a place for hunting, fishing and off-roading, far from the cities. fresh air on the northern border: hunting, fishing and off-road trails.
